outputs.explanation: Panel A contains bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity already overlays individual data points (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre mice).

Panel C is composed of histology/fluorescence/RNAscope micrographs and spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression overlaid on tissue coordinates); heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots (running enrichment score curves), which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression statistical testing (Seurat FindMarkers) across many transcriptomic spots/cells rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates; individual data points are not meaningful/practical to overlay in this context.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images (micrographs/photographs), not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
